title: Forbidden Code: Survivor
source: Pinned Windows 0.4.7 gameplay snapshot; regenerate using Scripts/export_browser_rules.py

cards.name: PULSE DART
cards.description:
Rapid neon energy bolts.
A precise, compact kinetic spark.

evolutions.name: WEAKPOINT COMPILER
evolutions.description: Repeated hits on the same living target build up to 3 precision stacks, +15% damage each.

evolutions.name: PACKET NOVA
evolutions.description: Eight radial darts share a 1.5x volley damage budget. Each dart deals 18.75% damage; maximum 6 pierces.

cards.name: PRISM BURST
cards.description:
Three pink plasma charges.
Colliding sparks bloom on impact.

evolutions.name: AURA CASCADE
evolutions.description: Pink impact bursts leave a short damaging aura. Secondary damage cannot trigger itself.

evolutions.name: PRISM NOVA
evolutions.description: Eight compact charges form a circle. Each deals 50% volley damage; area remains capped.

cards.name: HALO NOVA
cards.description:
Eight radiant energy shards.
A piercing 360-degree pulse.

evolutions.name: RETURNING HALO
evolutions.description: Shards return to the rider and can hit once again on their return leg.

evolutions.name: SANCTUARY RING
evolutions.description: An expanding ring briefly slows enemies it reaches. Boss slow is reduced.

cards.name: KINETIC CARDS
cards.description:
Spin electric-gold holographic cards.
Shatter into charged geometric sparks.

evolutions.name: LOADED DECK
evolutions.description: Cards lodge energy marks. The third mark detonates for 90% card damage in 150cm.

evolutions.name: HOUSE EDGE
evolutions.description: Three cards ricochet between nearby targets. Each card uses 60% damage; 3 hits maximum.

cards.name: PHOTON LANCE
cards.description:
A focused cyan energy lance.
Passes through four enemies.

evolutions.name: ARMOR DECODER
evolutions.description: Lances deal 50% bonus damage against elites and bosses and bypass directional armor.

evolutions.name: CROSS COMPILER
evolutions.description: Fire a perpendicular cross through the target. Each lance deals 60% damage.

cards.name: TALISMAN GUARD
cards.description: Three consumable wards. Basic: 1 charge; medium: 2; elite: 3. Bosses cost 4 charges for 8% max HP. Rank-ups replenish charges; cap 8.

evolutions.name: RECOVERY SIGILS
evolutions.description: Gain 4 charges. Recover one charge every 18s while at least one charge remains. Maximum 8.

evolutions.name: REACTIVE WARD
evolutions.description: Gain 4 charges. A consumed charge emits a 100cm pulse for 45 damage. No recursive echoes.

cards.name: ARC RELAY
cards.description:
22 damage. Chains to 4 targets.
320cm jumps; 18% decay per hop.

evolutions.name: LONG NETWORK
evolutions.description: Chain reach grows to 500cm; damage falls 18% each hop. Maximum 8 targets.

evolutions.name: RETURN SIGNAL
evolutions.description: A final bolt returns to the first surviving target for 60% initial damage.

cards.name: GHOST LINK
cards.description:
14 damage. Six linked targets.
240cm jumps; 10% decay per hop.

evolutions.name: SOUL CACHE
evolutions.description: Linked enemies are slowed 25% for 1.5s and yield research toward a stolen routine.

evolutions.name: GHOST DECOY
evolutions.description: Create a digital decoy at the final link for 2s. Basic enemies investigate it.

cards.name: NEON CATACLYSM
cards.description:
78 area damage within 300cm.
A pink charge detonates after 0.45s.

evolutions.name: AFTERSHOCK
evolutions.description: A second 50% damage burst follows the clearly marked primary blast after 0.35s.

evolutions.name: DENSE CORE
evolutions.description: Shrink the blast to 230cm and deal 80% extra damage. Maximum two simultaneous charges.

cards.name: ORBIT RAZOR
cards.description:
Two returning crescent blades.
28 damage; each pierces 4 targets.

evolutions.name: RECALL EDGE
evolutions.description: Returning blades may hit each enemy once per leg. Return damage is 70%.

evolutions.name: CLOSE ORBIT
evolutions.description: Blades orbit the rider before release, covering nearby enemies. Maximum 4 blades.

cards.name: RICOCHET SEAL
cards.description:
24 damage per impact.
A jade seal rebounds to 3 more foes.

evolutions.name: BANK SHOT
evolutions.description: Rebound off one wall and gain 35% damage after the wall bounce.

evolutions.name: JADE NETWORK
evolutions.description: Ricochet to 6 distinct enemies within 420cm; damage falls 12% each hop.

cards.name: STROBE RAIL
cards.description:
46 damage along a 1200cm rail.
A 32cm wide flash pierces the line.

evolutions.name: PERFECT ALIGNMENT
evolutions.description: Each successive enemy on the rail takes 12% more damage, capped at +60%.

evolutions.name: TWIN TRACKS
evolutions.description: Fire two parallel 24cm rails, each dealing 70% damage. Walls stop both rails.

cards.name: ECHO PETALS
cards.description:
Six spiraling coral petals.
16 damage each; one target per petal.

evolutions.name: BLOOM ORBIT
evolutions.description: Petals orbit for 0.5s before curving outward. Maximum 8 petals.

evolutions.name: PETAL REPRISE
evolutions.description: Petals curve back toward the rider and may hit once on each leg at 65% return damage.

cards.name: EVENT HORIZON
cards.description:
Four 16-damage pulses over 1.4s.
A 230cm violet energy field.

evolutions.name: GRAVITY WELL
evolutions.description: Four pulses pull basic enemies toward the center. Elite pull is reduced; bosses resist it.

evolutions.name: COLLAPSE
evolutions.description: The final pulse implodes for 3x pulse damage within the same capped field.

cards.name: SHATTER SIGIL
cards.description:
34 damage. Splits on contact
into five 12-damage amber fragments.

evolutions.name: SHAPED CHARGE
evolutions.description: Seven fragments fan forward from impact. Each deals 14 damage and pierces one enemy.

evolutions.name: AMBER RING
evolutions.description: Eight fragments radiate from impact for 10 damage each. Fragments cannot split again.

cards.name: SATELLITE CHOIR
cards.description:
Three homing aquamarine orbs.
18 damage each after a short orbit.

evolutions.name: HUNTER CHOIR
evolutions.description: Orbs prioritize the marked target, then the strongest visible enemy; +35% elite damage.

evolutions.name: FINISHER CHOIR
evolutions.description: Orbs seek the lowest health fraction and gain +60% damage against targets below 30% HP.

challenges.title: OVERLOAD ORB
challenges.reward: TRIPLE outgoing spell damage for 45 seconds.
challenges.risk: A vulnerable neon orb circles you. Enemy contact ruptures it: lose 50% of MAXIMUM health and the damage bonus. This CAN KILL you at half health or below. Orb arms after 1 second.

challenges.title: UNSTABLE ECHO
challenges.reward: Every third spell hit creates a blast dealing TWICE that hit's damage within 180 cm. Active for 40 seconds.
challenges.risk: The marked blast detonates after 1 second. Standing inside costs 20% of MAXIMUM health, even during ordinary hit immunity. Keep moving! At most one echo every 0.5 seconds.

challenges.title: HOSTILE BROADCAST
challenges.reward: DOUBLE essence dropped by enemies defeated during this 60-second contract.
challenges.risk: Two hunters arrive at 15, 30 and 45 seconds. Medium patrols early; elites after 180s with a developed loadout. A three-second warning precedes each wave. Hunters remain until defeated.

challenges.title: DEADMAN BATTERY
challenges.reward: DOUBLE outgoing spell damage for 30 seconds. Kills restore 1% maximum health, limited to three heals per second.
challenges.risk: The battery drains 2% of MAXIMUM health per second, even during hit immunity. The drain CAN KILL you. Keep defeating enemies to stay charged.

challenges.title: GLASS PROTOCOL
challenges.reward: 75% more outgoing damage and TWO extra penetrations for attacks that support piercing. Active for 45 seconds.
challenges.risk: ALL incoming damage is DOUBLED for the same 45 seconds. A fractured holographic shell marks your vulnerability. Previously fired shots keep their launch-time penetration count.

challenges.title: JACKPOT COURIER
challenges.reward: Collect the marked volatile data cache and return to THIS sign within 35 seconds to earn ONE bonus three-card upgrade selection.
challenges.risk: While carrying the cache, pursuing enemies move 25% FASTER. Missing the delivery deadline causes 35% MAXIMUM-HP backlash. Follow the objective marker back to this sign.

challenges.title: LOCKDOWN DUEL
challenges.reward: Defeat the marked elite INSIDE the 9-meter-radius ring within 40 seconds. Earn ONE bonus three-card draft and 24 essence.
challenges.risk: Stay inside the visible ring. More than 2 seconds outside, leaving its elevation, or running out of time fails the contract and costs 35% MAXIMUM health. Normal enemies can enter. No invisible walls.

riders.name: NEON EXORCIST
riders.description: The original rider. Forbidden energy programs, captured spirits and a custom neon board.
perks: OPEN SIGNAL / Flexible builds across every energy school.
DECK FREEDOM / Choose two unlocked starters; draft every program during a run.
BASELINE / Standard health, movement and damage.

riders.name: VEX
riders.description: An agile street courier who redirects the horde and extends energy networks.
perks: AFTERIMAGE / Boost leaves a 1.5s decoy. 6s cooldown; basic enemies only.
GHOST ROUTING / Chain attacks gain one target and 15% more jump reach.

riders.name: ROOK
riders.description: An armored street protector who turns collected essence into defensive energy.
perks: WARD RECHARGE / Every 25 essence restores 15% max-health shield; cap 30%.
REPULSOR / Boost emits a 35-damage, 350cm push pulse. 6s cooldown.

riders.name: ZERO
riders.description: A disciplined cyberpunk assassin. Lock a priority target and pierce the line.
perks: TARGET LOCK / Three direct hits in 2s mark one foe for 4s: +25% damage.
PERFECT LINE / Every third projectile cast adds two pierces to its first shot.

riders.name: MIRA
riders.description: An underground signal DJ who conducts captured digital spirits into combat.
perks: BOUND DAEMON / Permanent familiar fires every 1.2s; damage grows with level.
POSSESSION / Every 20 summon hits converts a basic enemy for 8s. 10s cooldown.
TRADEOFF / Own weapons deal 15% less damage; summons retain full power.
